_note: Worked example of a Plan conforming to src/contracts/action.ts. Built by Oriol for the live-loop run. The CLI retargets it onto a patient with an unreviewed letter at run time, so it is patient-agnostic; Albert owns the real clinical plans and should replace the rationales with sourced ones. Every action here was verified against the live server.
_patient: SIM-000001 Amira Khan. Goals: understand the next step, avoid unnecessary travel, stay at home with a clear contact. Needs: home visit, carer involvement.
_versions: expectedVersion values are resolved at RUN TIME by re-reading the resource. The values below are the versions observed at authoring time; if the world has moved on, the loop gets a 409 'Stale resource version' and its reread-retry fallback fires. That is correct behaviour, not a bug.
rationale: Keep the patient at home: review the discharge letter, bring the carer in, and take the monitoring to them rather than them to the clinic.

actions.rationale: Open a tracked task so the discharge handover cannot be dropped.

action.title: Discharge follow-up: home-first pathway
action.text: Monitoring handover received. Patient prefers to avoid travel; carer to be involved.

actions.rationale: Assign the letter to the duty GP so it can be reviewed. Assignment is a prerequisite for review.
Clinical review of the discharge letter. A human signs this off; the agent never reviews a letter on its own.

action.text: Monitoring handover checked. Home-first plan appropriate. Carer to be involved.

actions.rationale: Bloods to confirm the monitoring picture before changing anything. Routine, collected on the home visit rather than at clinic.

bloodTestOrder.panel: Full blood count and renal profile
bloodTestOrder.clinicalDetails: Post-discharge monitoring. Patient housebound by preference; collect at home visit.

actions.rationale: The home visit is the whole point of the plan: it is what removes the journey.
Give the patient the clear point of contact they asked for, in the conversation they already use.

messagingCommand.body: Home visit arranged with the community nurse. Bloods will be taken at home. Your carer is welcome to be there.
